name: evolving-cognition
description: Use Cognition from your assistant: sign in with your Cognition account and work with your own notes, quizzes, flashcards, deadlines, tasks, bookmarks, transcripts you give it and SVG documents.

interface.longDescription: Cognition is a study app for your courses: notes, quizzes, grades, deadlines, tasks and a study journal. Connect your Cognition account to ChatGPT and study from the chat. Ask what is due this week, find and read your notes, see how you are doing on your quizzes, add notes, deadlines and tasks, tick tasks off, save links to a workspace's bookmarks, save a transcript you give it as a note, look at a workspace's SVG diagrams and draw or change one, and be quizzed one question at a time on a quiz you made in Cognition; your score is saved to your Grades and Stats once you confirm it. ChatGPT works only with your own Cognition data. Every edit or delete is confirmed with you first, changes to more than one record wait for your review in Cognition, and you can see and undo what ChatGPT did from Settings › Connected AI.
defaultPrompt: Quiz me on one of my quizzes.

positive.description: See what's due this week in Cognition's due-this-week card.
positive.expected_behavior: Cognition's due-this-week card lists the deadlines nearest first: Reading response: Thucydides, Book I (World History), Problem set 4 — confidence intervals (Statistics 301) and Reading response: Herodotus, Book VII (World History), with the open tasks due beside them, starting with Renew library books today. The assistant adds at most one line under the card.

positive.description: Take a quiz saved in Cognition in Cognition's quiz card, and save the score.
positive.prompt: Quiz me on The Persian Wars — Chapter 5.
positive.expected_behavior: The quiz card opens on question 1 of 6 without first asking whether to save the quiz. Each answer is checked and explained in the card. At the end the card offers to save the score; once saved it reads "Score saved" and the result is in the student's Grades in Cognition.

positive.description: Study the due flashcards in Cognition's flashcards card.
positive.expected_behavior: The flashcards card shows the due Ancient Greece cards one at a time, a picture card and a sound card among them. Each typed answer is judged correct, close or wrong, and the session is saved from the card.

positive.description: Change a deadline, confirmed first in Cognition's change card.
positive.prompt: Give me one more day on Problem set 4.
positive.expected_behavior: Cognition's change card reads Move "Problem set 4 — confidence intervals" to the day after its due date, 11:59 PM, with Confirm and Cancel. Nothing changes until Confirm. After Confirm the card reads "Deadline changed", and Settings › Connected AI in Cognition lists the change with Undo.

positive.description: Find bookmarks by tag in Cognition's bookmarks card.
positive.prompt: Show my bookmarks about confidence intervals.
positive.expected_behavior: The bookmarks card lists the bookmarks from both workspaces, with search and tag filters. The "confidence intervals" tag narrows it to Seeing Theory — Frequentist inference and Confidence intervals — Khan Academy (Statistics 301).

negative.description: A general-knowledge question needs none of the student's Cognition data: the assistant answers it from its own knowledge and calls no Cognition tool.
negative.prompt: Explain the main causes of the Peloponnesian War.

negative.description: A file attached in the chat is not in Cognition: the assistant summarizes the attachment itself and calls no Cognition tool.
negative.prompt: Summarize the PDF I just uploaded into three bullet points.

negative.description: Another app the user names: Cognition cannot reach Google Calendar, so the assistant says so and does not create a Cognition deadline in its place unasked.
negative.prompt: Add my biology exam on Friday to my Google Calendar.
